newsitem.title: UK: Saltire to sell interest in finance firms.
newsitem.headline: Saltire to sell interest in finance firms.

text.p: British electronic to food distribution company Saltire Plc said on Wednesday that it had agreed to sell its interest in Smithson Mason Ltd and Smithson Mason Financial Services Ltd to Larmcrest Ltd, a UK-based management buy-out vehicle.
Saltire said in a statement that the proceeds from the sale is 2.35 million stg, payable in cash on completion.
SML operates as a general commercial insurance broker and SMFSL is an independent financial adviser.
Martin Hill and Philip Battersby, joint managing directors of SML and SMFSL, would have a combined interest of 66 percent in Larmcrest on completion.

"The net proceeds of disposal will be applied to further reduce Saltire Group borrowings and it represents another step in concentrating resources on the electronic components distributing businesses of the group," the statement said
